items.title: Engram is a sampler that turns broken AI hallucinations into music
items.summary: Music startup Thoughtful Things has just launched the Kickstarter campaign for its first instrument, Engram. It's a sampler and groovebox that uses AI to mangle incoming audio and even hallucinate completely new sounds.
